sourceAudit.patchChainObservation: Repository-wide search found the Formal A/B buy/stop formula constants only in Worker.js/snapshot, with no later scripts redefining those exact formulas on current main.

channelA.note: Actual A stop risk can be larger when recentLow5Prev - 0.12*ATR lies below support*0.98.

channelB.note: Actual B stop risk can be larger when 0.65*ATR exceeds 1.2% of breakout.

falsificationFinding: Projected stop-risk intensity is mechanically channel-confounded before any market outcome is observed. A/B mix must therefore be controlled before interpreting portfolio heat differences as an independent risk signal.
nonClaims: Does not prove A has worse realized risk than B.
Does not justify a portfolio heat threshold.
Does not alter Formal stop, entry, allocation, ADD/REDUCE or selection logic.
